Rivers flow beyond the realm of earth, and mountain hues shimmer between presence and absence. Sun Yuan once gazed upon the Scenic Scroll of the Three Hundred Miles of Jialing River. Inspired, he climbed to a high peak. In a moment of exhilaration, he wielded his fan with the flourish of splattered ink, as if painting with the mountains themselves, each stroke unstoppable, like a living landscape. But once the trance faded, he could never use that fan technique again.
Ten years passed. A bell chimed in the clouds. And in that instant, Sun Yuan recalled the feeling, and the Inkwell Fan resurfaced in the jianghu once more.

An old Qinchuan ballad says: "When the Golden Peach returns across Qinchuan, it will enter the city to save Chang'an." It foretells that as the Tang dynasty's imperial aura wanes, a wandering hero bearing the Golden Peach will emerge to aid Chang'an. 

When the Xuanyuan Sect arrived at Pomen Village, a new prophecy surfaced: "Two suns cannot share the sky; one must retreat to the western edge, far from the throne." This implies the Golden Peach's power rivals imperial authority, hence its past retreat to the western regions to avoid confrontation. 

Remarkably, the two prophecies align perfectly! The Golden Peach is indeed a supreme treasure, pivotal in the struggle for dominance, and the martial world will surely be embroiled in fierce battles.
